usedFor: buttondown holds your newsletter, and Google Docs receives the text from “email created” through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “email created” in buttondown, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new issue lands in a document tab, giving editors a working copy outside the newsletter tool.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's content, so choose add unless you want overwriting.
